goals.title: Firmware build
goals.objective: STEP 1 — Gesture-enabled main.c builds with 0 errors via pio run
goals.evidence: pio run SUCCESS (exit 0), no warnings. RAM 17.0% / Flash 2.8%. Gesture support implemented in src/main.c: GESTURE_CMD_ID 0xF0 accepted in UART ISR, PWM_Control_Task drives 6 finger channels (TIM3 CH1-4, TIM4 CH1-2); GRIP=30deg, OPEN=180deg.

goals.title: Hardware setup
goals.objective: STEP 2-3 — External servo power + common GND verified, firmware flashed, USB-UART terminal connected (115200 8-N-1 HEX)

goals.title: Gesture test
goals.objective: STEP 4 — GRIP (AA F0 00 01 F1) and OPEN (AA F0 00 00 F0) drive all 6 finger servos; mirror-assembly decision made (STEP 4-1 applied if needed)

goals.title: Regression test
goals.objective: STEP 5 — Individual servo commands still work and bad-checksum frames are rejected

goals.title: Calibration
goals.objective: STEP 6 — FINGER_OPEN_ANGLE / FINGER_GRIP_ANGLE tuned to real hardware, rebuilt and re-verified

goals.title: Final verification
goals.objective: STEP 7 — USART1 IRQ priority vs configLIBRARY_MAX_SYSCALL_INTERRUPT_PRIORITY checked, boot pose decided, task stack high-water measured

claudeObjective: Complete all ultragoal stories in .omc/ultragoal/goals.json: G001-firmware-build Firmware build; G002-hardware-setup Hardware setup; G003-gesture-test Gesture test; G004-regression-test Regression test; G005-calibration Calibration; G006-final-verification Final verification
